explanation: A popular story, but untrue. Commandant Jules Repond introduced the blue, red and yellow uniforms in 1914, basing them on 16th-century pictures of the guard, which dates from 1506.

claims.text: Michelangelo did not design the Swiss Guard's uniforms.
Commandant Jules Repond introduced the Swiss Guard's uniform design in 1914.
Repond based the uniform on 16th-century depictions of the guard.
The Swiss Guard's uniforms are striped in blue, red and yellow.
The Pontifical Swiss Guard was founded in 1506.
